config:
asset_classes:
- equity
equity:
  market: HK
  factor: comp_quality
  neutral: plain
  weighting: cap
  tier: 1
  shortable: true
universe_filters:
- type: HistoryFilter
  params:
    min_days: 252
- type: DataIntegrityFilter
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: adv_usd
    min_value: 3000000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: raw_close
    min_value: 1.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: mcap_usd
    min_value: 200000000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: TradedDaysFilter
  params:
    min_share: 0.9
    lookback: 63
- type: OneClassPerIssuer
- type: ShortableFilter
  params:
    mode: passthrough
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: universe_member
    min_value: 0.5
    exit_ratio: 1.0
    lag: 0
vol_normalizer:
  type: Identity
signals:
- type: CrossSectionalSignal
  weight: 1.0
  params:
    indicator:
      type: CompositeCharacteristic
      params:
        panels:
          gpa: 0.2
          op_be: 0.2
          cbop: 0.2
          roe: 0.2
          roic: 0.2
          accruals: -0.25
          pct_accruals: -0.25
          noa: -0.25
          beneish: -0.25
          leverage: -0.25
          evol5: -0.25
          oscore: -0.25
          zscore: 0.25
          fscore: 0.5
          gm_trend: 0.25
          at_trend: 0.25
        winsor: 0.01
        min_components: 6
    ranker:
      type: PercentileRank
      params:
        min_names: 40
    position_function:
      type: ValueWeightedQuantilePortfolio
      params:
        long_pct: 0.3
        short_pct: 0.3
        size_split: true
        big_share: 0.9
        max_weight: 0.05
        cap_method: redistribute
asset_allocator:
  type: Identity
model_gearing:
  type: XSVolTarget
  params:
    target_vol: 0.1
    vol_lookback: 126
    leverage_cap: 5.0
    buffer: 0.1
    min_gross: 0.2
cost_model:
  type: EquityCosts
  params:
    market: HK
rebalance: monthly
position_smoothing: 10
smoothing_method: sma
group_level: sector
